items.name: Besan (Gram Flour), Raw
items.src: NIN Nutritive Value of Indian Foods / USDA chickpea flour (387) and IFCT B001 chana dal; fibre energy counted at 2 kcal/g
items.note: raw flour; kcal for fried or cooked besan dishes is much higher or lower, log those separately

items.name: Sattu (Roasted Gram Flour)
items.src: IFCT 2017 B001 chana dal, dry-roasted (about 4% moisture loss); sattu packs list 350-390
items.note: roasted chana flour (not barley); barley sattu is listed separately

items.name: Sattu, Barley (Jau Sattu)
items.src: IFCT 2017 A004 barley, roasting adjusts moisture; estimate
items.note: roasted barley flour used for cooling sattu drink; brand values vary 320-350

items.name: Roasted Chana (Bhuna Chana, With Skin)
items.src: IFCT 2017 B002 kala chana scaled for dry roasting (~7% moisture loss); labels list 360-380 as they count fibre fully
items.note: dry roasted, unsalted, with skin; salted or masala varieties are higher in sodium

items.name: Roasted Chana Dal (Phutana / Pottukadalai)
items.src: IFCT 2017 B001 chana dal scaled for dry roasting; labels 360-380
items.note: skinless roasted split chickpea, unsalted

items.name: Kabuli Chana (White Chickpea), Dry (raw)
items.src: USDA chickpea mature raw (378) adjusted to available carbohydrate; NIN 'Bengal gram' 360
items.note: dry raw; soaked and boiled chole is about 130 kcal per 100 g

items.name: Soya Chunks, Dry (Nutrela type)
items.src: defatted soya chunk pack labels (345 kcal, P 52); IFCT soybean checked
items.note: dry weight; soaked chunks are about 3x heavier (about 115 kcal per 100 g)

items.name: Soya Flour (Defatted)
items.src: USDA defatted soy flour (330); IFCT soya bean B024/B025 for fibre
items.note: defatted; full-fat soy flour is about 430 kcal with 20 g fat

items.name: Tofu (Soya Paneer), Firm
items.src: USDA tofu firm (calcium sulfate) 144 and regular firm Indian packs 110-130
items.note: firm tofu; soft or silken tofu is 55-80 kcal

items.name: Moong Dal Chilka (Split Green Gram With Skin), Dry (raw)
items.src: interpolated between IFCT 2017 B010 (dal) and B011 (whole green gram)

items.name: Matar Dal (Yellow Split Peas), Dry (raw)
items.src: USDA split peas raw (341) and IFCT 2017 B017 dry peas; dehusked so lower fibre than whole peas

items.name: Ragi Flour (Nachni Atta)
items.src: IFCT 2017 A010 (whole-grain flour has the same composition)
items.note: raw flour; ragi roti or ragi mudde is much lower per 100 g

items.name: Jowar Flour (Jowar Atta)
items.src: IFCT 2017 A005 (whole-grain flour has the same composition)
items.note: raw flour; jowar bhakri is lower per 100 g

items.name: Bajra Flour (Bajra Atta)
items.src: IFCT 2017 A003 (whole-grain flour has the same composition)
items.note: raw flour; bajra roti is lower per 100 g

items.name: Makki Ka Atta (Maize Flour)
items.src: IFCT 2017 A006 maize dry
items.note: stone-ground whole maize; degermed packaged makki atta has less fibre and fat (about 350 kcal)

items.name: Rice Flour (Chawal Ka Atta)
items.src: IFCT 2017 A015 rice raw milled, ground; USDA rice flour 366
items.note: raw flour

items.name: Cornflour (Corn Starch)
items.src: USDA corn starch (381) / Indian pack labels 360-380
items.note: thickener powder, not makki atta

items.name: Arrowroot Powder (Araroot)
items.src: USDA arrowroot flour (357) / pack labels 340-360

items.name: Sabudana (Sago / Tapioca Pearls), Dry (raw)
items.src: NIN Nutritive Value of Indian Foods (sago 351 kcal) / IFCT tapioca F015 dry-matter check
items.note: dry pearls; soaked sabudana is about 3x heavier

items.name: Oats, Rolled (Dry)
items.src: Indian pack labels (Quaker, Saffola oats 370-390) and USDA rolled oats 379
items.note: plain unflavoured oats, dry; cooked oats porridge is about 70 kcal per 100 g

items.name: Cornflakes, Plain (Dry)
items.src: USDA corn flakes (357) and Indian pack labels (Kellogg's 360-380, Na about 600-700)
items.note: dry cereal without milk; chocolate or frosted varieties are 380-400

items.note: raw; cooked basmati is about 130 kcal per 100 g

items.src: IFCT 2017 A013 brown rice and A014 parboiled rice, red bran retained; Indian pack labels 345-360
items.note: raw; cooked is about 125 kcal per 100 g

items.name: Black Rice (Chak-Hao), Raw

items.note: raw; cooked is about 130 kcal per 100 g

items.name: Sticky Rice (Bora Saul), Raw

items.note: raw; cooked sticky rice is about 135 kcal per 100 g

items.name: Ponni Rice, Raw

items.name: Kuttu Atta (Buckwheat Flour)

items.name: Singhare Ka Atta (Water Chestnut Flour)
items.src: Indian pack labels (330-370 kcal) and USDA water chestnut dehydrated check

items.name: Rajgira Atta (Amaranth Flour)
items.src: IFCT 2017 A001/A002 amaranth seed (flour from the same grain)

items.name: Multigrain Atta
items.src: Indian pack labels (Aashirvaad, Pillsbury multigrain 335-350) and IFCT atta/ragi/oats/soya blend

items.name: Idli Rava (Rice Rava), Raw

items.name: Makhana (Fox Nut / Lotus Seeds), Dry
items.src: NIN Nutritive Value of Indian Foods (makhana 347 kcal); Indian pack labels 340-360
items.note: plain dry or dry-roasted; roasted in ghee or oil it is 400+ kcal

items.name: Dates, Medjool (Soft / Fresh Khajoor)

items.name: Dried Cranberries (Sweetened)

items.name: Charoli (Chironji)
items.src: NIN Nutritive Value of Indian Foods (chironji 656 kcal; P 19, F 59.1)
items.note: carbohydrate shown as available carbohydrate (NIN total 12.1 g includes fibre)

items.name: Peanuts, Roasted (Bhuna Moongphali), Unsalted
items.src: IFCT 2017 H012 groundnut scaled for dry roasting (~5% moisture loss); USDA dry roasted peanuts 585
items.note: dry roasted, no oil, no salt; salted roasted peanuts add about 400 mg sodium per 100 g

items.name: Peanuts, Boiled (Ubli Moongphali)
items.src: USDA peanuts boiled with salt (318 kcal)
items.note: lightly salted; edible kernels weight, shells removed

items.src: USDA chia seeds dried (486) and Indian pack labels 480-490
items.note: kcal follows labels, which count fibre fully

items.src: USDA pumpkin seed kernels dried (559)

items.note: kernels only, shells removed; USDA lists no fibre

items.src: USDA peanut butter (588) and Indian pack labels (590-620)
items.note: salted with a little added sugar and oil; unsweetened natural spread is about 590 kcal with low sodium

items.src: pure fat, 9 kcal/g (USDA 884)
items.note: all cooking oils are about 900 kcal per 100 g; 1 tsp is 45 kcal

items.src: NIN Nutritive Value of Indian Foods (398 kcal); USDA 387
items.note: 1 tsp = 5 g = 20 kcal

items.name: Sugar, Brown

items.name: Khandsari Sugar (Unrefined)
items.src: NIN sugar 398 minus about 1% moisture and molasses; pack labels 385-398

items.name: Sugar, Powdered (Boora)
items.src: sugar with about 3% anti-caking starch; pack labels 390-398

items.name: Mishri (Rock Sugar / Crystal Sugar)
items.src: crystallised sucrose, same as white sugar (NIN 398)

items.name: Palm Jaggery (Karupatti / Nolen Gur)
items.src: estimate from IFCT 2017 I001 cane jaggery (354) and published palm jaggery analyses
items.note: date-palm or palmyra jaggery; moisture varies

items.name: Honey (Shahad)
items.src: NIN honey (319) and USDA honey (304); Indian pack labels 310-330
items.note: 1 tsp = 7 g = about 22 kcal

items.name: Glucose Powder (Dextrose)
items.src: dextrose monohydrate 3.75 kcal/g; branded glucose-D mixes list 375-385
items.note: pure glucose, fast sugar for low blood sugar; flavoured mixes add vitamins and salts

items.name: Ghee, Cow (Gaay Ka Ghee)
items.src: IFCT 2017 T013 ghee (fat 100 g, IFCT energy blank) and USDA butter oil 876; fat 99.5 g x 9
items.note: 1 tsp = 45 kcal; A2 or desi cow ghee has the same energy as other ghee

items.name: Ghee, Buffalo (Bhains Ka Ghee)
items.src: IFCT 2017 T013 ghee; fat 99.5 g x 9
items.note: white, less carotene than cow ghee, same energy

items.name: Butter, Salted
items.src: Indian pack labels (Amul butter 722 kcal, fat 80+) and USDA butter salted (717)
items.note: 1 tsp = 36 kcal; unsalted butter has about 10 mg sodium

items.name: Makhan (Homemade White Butter)
items.src: USDA butter unsalted (717); home-churned from malai or dahi is 78-82% fat
items.note: unsalted, churned from malai or dahi; fresh makhan carries more water so 700-720

items.name: Garam Masala (Salt-Free Powder)
items.src: estimated from IFCT 2017 coriander G024, cumin G025, pepper G031, cardamom G020, cloves G023; pack labels 270-330
items.note: salt-free blend; some brands add salt; 1 tsp is only about 7 kcal

items.name: Kasuri Methi (Dried Fenugreek Leaves)
items.src: IFCT 2017 C020 fenugreek leaves (34 kcal) concentrated about 6.5x for ~6% moisture; pack labels 270-330
items.note: dried herb, used in pinches

items.name: Saunf (Fennel Seeds)
items.src: USDA fennel seed (345)

items.name: Dalchini (Cinnamon)
items.src: USDA cinnamon ground (247)
items.note: cassia and Ceylon cinnamon differ little in energy

items.name: Sonth (Dry Ginger Powder)
items.src: USDA ginger ground (335)

items.name: Tej Patta (Indian Bay Leaf), Dry
items.src: USDA bay leaf dried (313); Indian bay leaf (Cinnamomum tamala) is similar
items.note: flavouring leaf, removed before eating

items.name: Salt, Table (Namak, Iodised)
items.src: NaCl 97-99% (USDA table salt 38,758 mg sodium per 100 g)
items.note: 1 tsp (6 g) = about 2,300 mg sodium; WHO daily limit is under 2,000 mg sodium (5 g salt)

items.name: Rock Salt (Sendha Namak)
items.src: NaCl about 96-98%; sodium about 37,000-38,500 mg per 100 g
items.note: used for fasting; sodium content is practically the same as table salt

items.name: Salt, Low Sodium (Potassium Blend)
items.src: 50:50 NaCl and KCl blends (about 19,500 mg sodium and 17,000 mg potassium per 100 g)
items.note: about half the sodium of table salt; contains potassium, ask the doctor first if on ACE-inhibitor, ARB or kidney disease
